meta.description: Moves whole stems sideways, so a circle around each of them stays clear of the others, like the plants of a group that each need their room. The stems keep their shape and what grows on them moves along.

plant.description: The stems to move apart. Only paths that don't grow on another path move.

radius.description: The room every stem needs around it, e.g. the radius of its cap or crown. Read for every stem, with its length in path_info, so it can follow the size of each.

at.description: Where along a stem its place is measured. 0 is the base, 1 the tip, where a cap sits.

iterations.description: How often the stems are moved. More iterations settle a dense group.

lean.description: The base of every stem stays where it is and the stem leans aside instead, so its place at `at` moves as far as the whole stem would. For stems that start on a substrate, which a move would lift off it.
